THE FINDING WORTH MORE THAN THE CLOSE: three separately-measured bars in two accepted parks were ALIGNMENT ARTIFACTS, and one transposed line pair dissolved all three. attempt.WF_dcshandlerequest-inverse-rescreen-park-upheld.20260901.v1 upheld the park on 'BAR A the positional pair is li against li', 'BAR B the destination mismatch is unchanged' and 'BAR C the jumptable bar, re-measured and DECISIVE ON ITS OWN', and concluded 'NO PROOF MODE IN ANY DIRECTION CAN DISCHARGE AN OBLIGATION HERE, and reopening this would require weakening a guard'. Every one of those was measured with the form site at +0x1e0. After NC's case-17 initialiser transposition the site is +0x1e8: ours decodes ('copy',31,30) against the target's ('li',31,0), so BAR A is gone; both words write r31, so BAR B is gone; and BAR C is gone WITHOUT weakening anything, because prove_constant_source tests whether index+1 is an entry -- whether control can enter BETWEEN the definition and the site -- and the definition `li r30,0` sits AT the +0x1e0 case-entry rather than above it, so every path through the switch dispatch executes it on the way in. No guard was relaxed and no capability was built; the rule uses three shipped stages exactly as they are. THE SOURCE CAPS ARE UPHELD in full: the formal-passthrough matrix stays closed on its eight measured points across two constructs, and NC's two NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL probes (loop-head spelling, chained assignment unchained) stand as the statement-shape denial.
